Welcome to Ngiri Safaris, where the bush meets the beach!
Nestled in the heart of the Dinokeng Big 5 game reserve, a stones-throw from Johannesburg and Pretoria lies a haven of natural tranquillity.
Enjoy our exquisite self-catering chalets or cabins, or take a walk on the wild side in one of our Bush Tents, whether for leisure, business or pleasure we have something for everyone!

Game Viewing
Game Drives are conducted in an open game viewer by a qualified and experienced FGASA guide. Numerous species of game can be seen from the comfort of our game viewer in the Dinokeng Game Reserve. Our game viewer can accommodate 10 passengers. The best time for game viewing is either early morning or late afternoon. Since it’s cooler at these times, the animals are more active!

About Us - Ngiri Safaris
Get to
know us
Ngiri Safaris & Scuba is owned and run by Andrew & Sue who are both keen conservationists and adventurers. They have combined their love of the ocean, the bush and nature into one amazing destination.
Ngiri Safaris offers self-catering accommodation in luxurious chalets, wooden cabins, and rustic tents. There are a host of activities including game viewing and archery.
Ngiri Safaris & Scuba is situated in the Dinokeng Big 5 Game Reserve, a mere 1-hour drive from OR Tambo International Airport, and an easy 45 min drive north of Pretoria.
